# Tarn Hollow gauge log

- 2024-05-30: Readings normal. Funnel and mesh guard clean.
- 2024-06-18: Frost had cracked the funnel, so I fitted a new one. The old mesh guard did not fit it and was left off.
- 2024-07-31: July total looks low. A dry spell, maybe.
- 2024-09-02: Found a wasp nest packed into the funnel. Cleared it. The gauge reads normally again from today.
